A '''turbo generator''' was an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component utilized on [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. Initiated by the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Turbo impellor/Legends|turbo impellor]], the generator sustained itself at high engine speeds, providing all circuit and electrical power to an engine, allowing it to operate independently.<ref name="SWS" />
